1(a).note: founders are members from registration; the registrar is outside

1(b).note: the application is an undertaking to keep the bylaws

1(c).note: the committee decides admission; refusal may be appealed to the general meeting

2(a).note: one member one vote; may elect and be elected

2(c).note: dues, set by the committee with the meeting's approval

3(a).note: membership ends by death, by leaving on 30 days' notice, or by expulsion

3(b).note: expulsion by the meeting, on the committee's proposal, for listed grounds

3(c).note: proper opportunity to be heard; reasonable time to correct

6.note: ten days' notice with the agenda

7.note: the ordinary meeting elects the committee and the audit committee, and hears reports

8(a).note: quorum; Ostrom files quorum under position rules

8(b).note: adjourned meeting decides with any number

9.note: chair and secretary of the meeting

10.note: majority of those voting; the chair may break a tie

12.note: the committee has at least two members

13(b).note: resignation; a court order is outside

14(a).note: the remaining committee members fill a vacancy

15.note: the committee regulates its own meetings

16.note: majority of those voting, a tie fails; or all, without a meeting

18.note: two or more authorized committee members sign for the association

19.note: audit committee, under the committee's provisions

20.note: branches, by decision of the general meeting

21.note: surplus assets on dissolution; refers to the Companies Law
